content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 7-2. TYPICAL CARGO SLING WIRING DIAGRAM".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows a typical cargo sling wiring diagram.

Labels, values, units, part numbers, and notes printed in the figure:

- RELEASE SWITCH (ON CYCLIC CONTROL)
- RELEASE MASTER SWITCH
- Automatic
- Off
- On
- CIRCUIT BREAKER
- PRIMARY BUS
- QUICK RELEASE DEVICE
- RELEASE SOLENOID
- AUTO-RELEASE MICROSWITCH (Closes when load is reduced to preset value - usually 50-100 lb.)
- SAFETY MICROSWITCH (Release closed)
- OPEN RELEASE INDICATOR LIGHT
